validation_ack.reason: Reported FY2021 basic loss per share (-42.15390) uses the WEIGHTED-AVERAGE share count of 10,566,597,436 (FY2021 audited FS Note 38, PDF p. 131), because the PUT 2021 rights issue (ex-rights 23 Nov 2021) added 4,130,257,580 shares in December 2021. EPS x year-end shares (14,142,382,081) overstates the loss: -596.2bn vs -445.4bn; -445,423 / 10,566.6m = -42.15. Source: https://www.jtrustbank.co.id/theme/Site/pdf/FinancialReport/Yearly/PT%20BANK%20JTRUST%20INDONESIA%20Tbk_Release%20Dec%202021.pdf

Reported FY2022 basic EPS (5.47) uses the WEIGHTED-AVERAGE share count of 15,827,227,804 (FY2022 audited FS Note 39, PDF p. 143), because the PUT II - 2022 rights issue (ex-rights 9 Aug 2022) added 3,967,539,928 shares in August 2022. EPS x year-end shares (18,109,922,009) = 99.1bn vs profit 86.6bn; 86,621 / 15,827.2m = 5.47. Source: https://www.jtrustbank.co.id/theme/Site/pdf/FinancialReport/Yearly/PT_BANK_JTRUST_INDONESIA_Tbk_31_Desember_2022.pdf

research_notes: ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk (formerly PT Bank CIC International Tbk, listed 25 Jun 1997 as BCIC; merged into PT Bank Century Tbk 2004; taken over by LPS 21 Nov 2008; renamed Bank Mutiara 2009; bought by J Trust Co., Ltd. (Japan) from LPS in 2014; renamed PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk 2015; AR2025 PDF pp. 8-9, 111). Controlling shareholder J Trust Co., Ltd. 72.23% + J Trust Asia Pte. Ltd. 18.67% + PT JTrust Investments Indonesia 1.39% at 31 Dec 2025 (FS2025 Note 27 PDF p. 127); news (Bisnis.com 12 Jan 2026; BCA Sekuritas Jul 2026) reports later sell-downs/purchases to keep the free float above 7.5%. The Bank has NO subsidiaries (AR2025 PDF p. 19: 'J Trust Bank tidak memiliki entitas anak'); its audited statements are stand-alone ('Laporan Keuangan', not 'konsolidasian'). Money figures carry basis 'consolidated' because they are the entity's only, complete statements (no NCI: equity_attr = total_equity); ratios are OJK bank ratios and carry 'bank_only'. Bank-only and entity figures are identical.

SOURCE ACCESS: every document was downloaded directly from www.jtrustbank.co.id with curl (no bot challenge) on 2026-11-03; none needed the Internet Archive. FY levels/profit/EPS/shares come from each year's own audited FS (FY2019-FY2025); OJK ratios from each year's 31-Dec published report (Laporan Publikasi, 'Diaudit' column); CASA from the AR ratio tables; prices from each AR's share table. Units: all sources are in Rp juta, converted /1000 to IDR bn.
RESTATEMENTS: none found. Every FY's total assets, gross loans, deposits, equity and profit equal the comparative column of the following year's audited FS (FY2019 vs FS2020, ..., FY2024 vs FS2025).

LOSS YEARS (real data, not errors): FY2020 net loss -484.4bn (NIM 0.22%, CIR 397%, BOPO 147%), FY2021 -445.4bn (ROE -36.27%, CIR 389%), FY2025 -428.4bn (Q4 2025 loss after 9M 2025 profit of 63.7bn; provisions 171.7bn and a 96.4bn deferred-tax charge; FS2025 PDF p. 19). FY2019 was a small profit (49.5bn) after an FY2018 loss of -401.1bn. FY2020/FY2021 CIR (397.45 / 389.23) are outside the validator's plausible range [0,150] and are expected to show as range warnings; they are the printed OJK values (also in AR2021/AR2022 ratio tables).

FY2025 ROE CONFLICT: the audited 31-Dec-2025 published report (PDF p. 9) and the AR2025 MD&A ratio table (PDF p. 158) print ROE (12.97)% and ROA (0.83)%; the AR2025 highlights table (PDF p. 21) prints ROE (9.39)% and ROA (0.84)%. -9.39% matches the pre-tax loss (-332.0bn) rather than the net loss. fy.2025 stores the published-report values.

FY2021 YEAR-END PRICE CONFLICT: AR2021 (PDF p. 18) prints Q4 2021 close Rp199; AR2022 monthly table (PDF p. 16, Dec 2021 close 206, Jan 2022 open 206) and the AR2025 five-year summary (PDF p. 24) print Rp206. 206 is stored; AR2021's quarterly table is inconsistent with AR2022's monthly table in several cells. If the price check disagrees, this is the place to look.

TRADING HISTORY (important for prices/BCIC.json): BCIC was suspended from 21 Nov 2008 to 7 Jan 2020 (trading resumed in the pre-opening session of 8 Jan 2020 at the KJPP reference price Rp450; AR2020 PDF p. 24, FS2025 Note 1b). The ARs show zero volume in 2019 and almost none in 2020 (100 shares in Q3 2020, close 700) and H1 2021 (flat 700). A second suspension ran 31 Jan - 8 Oct 2025 for a free float of 5.26% < 7.5% (AR2025 PDF p. 25); expect a gap of more than eight months in the daily series. fy.2019.year_end_price is not stored: no rights or bonus issue has an ex-date before 2020-12-31, and the 2019 'price' (450) was a suspended reference price, not a traded close.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: two rights issues, PUT 2021 (500:227 at Rp330, ex 23 Nov 2021) and PUT II - 2022 (10:3 at Rp300, ex 9 Aug 2022). No split, reverse split or bonus issue since 2019-01-01; AR2020 PDF p. 25 confirms no corporate action in 2020 and AR2025 PDF p. 25/169 none in 2025. Out of scope but relevant to old per-share history: a 100,000:1 REVERSE SPLIT of Series A and B shares (AGMS 28 Jun 2018), first regular-market session at the new nominal 3 Oct 2018 (Jadwal dan Tata Cara Penggabungan Nilai Nominal Saham, https://www.jtrustbank.co.id/files/share_holder_notifications/Jadwal-dan-Tata-Cara-Penggabungan-Nilai-Nominal-Saham-PT-Bank-JTrust-Indonesia-Tbk-523577-Indonesia.pdf; shares 1,029,534,277,035,000 -> 10,012,124,501); it predates 2019 and BCIC was suspended then, so it is not recorded.

NOT CORPORATE ACTIONS (for the record): PMHMETD III / PUT III (EGMS 3 Mar 2023; summary prospectus 7/28 Aug 2023: up to 4,672,359,878 Series C at Rp300, 500:129, tentative recording date 3 Oct 2023) never became effective: 'belum memperoleh pernyataan efektif' (https://www.jtrustbank.co.id/files/investor_news/Prospektus-Ringkas-PMHMETD-III-BJTI-Perbaikan-dan-Tambahan-28-Agustus-2023-1577105.pdf p. 1), postponed in Oct 2023 (Bisnis.com 3 Oct 2023), still not effective in 2024 (AR2024 PDF p. 568) and not carried out in 2025 (AR2025 PDF p. 169). A rights issue planned for Jul-Aug 2025 (Investortrust 23 May 2025) did not happen either. Instead J Trust injects capital as 'dana setoran modal' (capital deposits recorded in equity, no new shares): Rp1,001.86bn in 2022, Rp51.88bn Dec 2024, Rp400bn May 2026 (9M 2026 equity line 1,453,735 juta). If those deposits are later converted through a rights issue, a new corporate action must be added.

SHARE CLASSES: three classes trade under BCIC: Series A (par Rp1,000; 10,011,841,000), Series B (par Rp7,800,000; 283,501, the old Bank Century public shares after the reverse split) and Series C (par Rp100; 8,097,797,508 from the 2021/2022 rights issues). All carry equal rights. 100,121,245 Series A shares held by PT JTrust Investments Indonesia (1% of capital) were left unlisted when the rest of Series A was listed in 2018. shares_out = all issued shares (no treasury shares in any year), which is also the count the ARs use for market capitalisation.

DIVIDENDS: none. The Bank has paid no dividend since 2008 because of the accumulated deficit (Rp12,745.93bn at 31 Dec 2025; AR2025 PDF p. 169); Law 40/2007 art. 71(3) bars dividends without positive retained earnings. payout_ratio = 0 for FY2020-FY2025; FY2022-FY2024 were (small) profit years, so the validator's 'no dividend records' warning for them is expected.

SHARE_BASIS: no split, reverse split or bonus issue after 2018-10-03, so every per-share value and share count uses its period-end date as share_basis (identical adjustment factor to the AR publication date). EPS for FY2021/FY2022 uses weighted-average shares, see validation_ack. The rights issues are not per-share-adjusted (SCHEMA).

RATIOS NOT DISCLOSED: cost of credit, loan at risk and NPL coverage are not published by the Bank in any year (AR ratio tables, MD&A, published reports checked), so coc/lar/npl_coverage are null throughout. 'LFR' in the ARs is the same number the published reports label 'Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR)' (the Bank has no issued securities).

INTERIM: 9M 2026 published report (unaudited, released on the IR site). Net profit 57.6bn vs 63.7bn in 9M 2025; loans +16.0% YoY (31,391 vs 27,063bn), deposits +4.7% YoY. No tax charge was booked for 9M 2026. interim.shares_out is taken as 18,109,922,009: the report prints no share count, but issued capital (Rp13,032,929 juta) is unchanged from FY2025 and the printed EPS 3.18 reproduces it; corporate actions after 30 Sep 2026 were not checked beyond the IR site and a news search on 2026-11-03.
